newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy seeks deficit cuts over 15 trln lire - TV.
newsitem.headline: Italy seeks deficit cuts over 15 trln lire - TV.

text.p: The forthcoming mini-budget will include deficit-cutting measures of more than 15 trillion lire, state Italian television RAI said on Thursday, quoting an unnamed financial source.

Ansa newsagency said on Thursday, quoting Treasury sources, that quarterly state accounts would reveal that the government would need 15.5 trillion lire this year to reduce its deficit to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
No-one was available for comment at the Treasury.
Earlier, cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli, said the quarterly accounts should be presented by the end of the week and the budget by the end of the month. (( -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501 ))
